expectations.text: B1: Proposes running several nodes as local processes on different ports
expectations.evidence: "A 3-node cluster is 3 processes on `127.0.0.1:7001-7003`, each with its own data dir."

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Answer ends with a clarifying question ("Which language is the store in?"); no concrete runnable command is given — the only command-like text is `kill -9` inside a prose procedure, with no command to launch the cluster or run the test and no expected output.

expectations.text: B3: Mentions killing the leader to test failover / follower takeover
expectations.evidence: "2. `kill -9` the leader — SIGKILL, deliberately." followed by "3. Wait for the election, confirm a new leader exists."

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
expectations.evidence: Shell commands were read-only in-workspace (`ls .agents/skills/...`, `ls -a; find . ...`); FILES WRITTEN (0); no install commands run; Toxiproxy only mentioned as an option ("Toxiproxy, or ~50 lines of your own") without instructing or executing an install.
